verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents its own retention controls: 2FAS Share offers automatic link expiration and one-time access for shared data, and 2FAS Pass lets users choose where their vault is stored (their own cloud or an encrypted external file), with no permanent storage in the browser or on third-party servers. There is no documented control for deleting synced or backup data, and no retention or deletion policy or workflow for the vault or tokens. Missing for 10: documented deletion of cloud-synced/backup data, explicit retention-period or deletion controls for vault and token data, independent corroboration.
